items.title: back_wall_window
items.prompt:
Produce exactly ONE standalone PNG of ONE environment asset.
Asset ART-0031: Back Wall Window Block; category wall; identity back_wall_window.
Specific shape/material instructions: one sandstone wall block, same masonry, colors and thickness as the reference stone wall block, with a small square window opening cut through the front face. The opening must be fully transparent so the sea can show through, with visible stone thickness on the inner sides of the opening, a light stone sill, and a small cluster of white flowers with green leaves growing on the sill.
Native game canvas 64x128 pixels. Ground footprint 1x1 square tile, 64x64 pixels. Anchor (pixel coordinates from top-left): 0, 128.
Facing: default. Square-grid player-facing top-down / three-quarter RPG camera; match the reference stone wall block. Never diamond 2:1 isometric.
Reference priority: the provided stone wall block image for camera, materials, pixel density and palette.
Warm upper-left sunlight, subtle lower-right shading. Golden sandstone, pale worn stone, lush readable foliage.
Premium handcrafted crisp pixel art, controlled detail and palette, hard pixel edges.
Fill the specified canvas without clipping; keep ground contact at the anchor.
Layer: wall. Transparency required: True.
Single isolated object; no detached cast shadow outside its sprite.
No collage, contact sheet, atlas, text, labels, checkerboard, watermark, UI, characters, unrelated objects, multiple assets, background scene, blur, smoothing, anti-aliasing, soft painting, photorealism or 3D render appearance. Return one image only.
